answer: Require every new agent to earn attestations from established peers before it can transact: each attestation is a signed, stake-backed vertex in a trust graph, and a sybil cluster forms an isolated lagoon with no edges to honest agents. Forging links costs real stake per edge, and one detected fraud lets a zephyr of slashing penalties sweep the whole cluster, so an attacker must pay honest-level costs for every fake identity instead of minting them free.
